groups.name: Reaching the update source
steps: Check that the machine reaches Windows Update, or its WSUS or Configuration Manager server: DNS, firewall and proxy.
Windows Update goes through the services proxy (WinHTTP), not the browser one. Diagnostics, Proxy shows both, and a WinHTTP proxy left over from another network.
Allow *.windowsupdate.com, *.update.microsoft.com and download.microsoft.com through the firewall and any TLS inspection.

groups.name: The component store is damaged
steps: From an elevated prompt, run DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /RestoreHealth.
Then run sfc /scannow.
Restart and install the update again.

groups.name: The downloaded update files
steps: Restart and try again: a partial or damaged download is fetched again.

If it fails the same way, reset the Windows Update components: stop the wuauserv and bits services, rename %windir%\SoftwareDistribution\DataStore, %windir%\SoftwareDistribution\Download and %windir%\System32\catroot2 to .bak, then start the services again.

groups.name: A restart is due
steps: Restart the machine, then check for updates again.
Diagnostics, Pending reboot shows what Windows is waiting for.

groups.name: Something blocks the installer
steps: Open the latest %windir%\Logs\CBS\CBS.log, look for the lines with error at the time of the failure, and read which file or registry key was refused.
Antivirus, backup and encryption tools are the usual cause: pause them or restart in a clean boot, then install again.

groups.name: The feature update rolled back
steps: Update the drivers and the BIOS, and disconnect every device but the keyboard, the mouse and the display.
Run SetupDiag from Microsoft: it reads the setup logs and names the cause.
The logs are in %windir%\Panther and in $Windows.~BT\Sources\Rollback.

groups.name: Not enough free space
steps: Free space on the system drive: Diagnostics, Storage health shows how much is left.
Disk Cleanup, with Clean up system files, removes old update files.

groups.name: Configuration or policy
steps: Check the Windows Update policies applied to the machine: WSUS server, deferrals, access to Windows Update.
On a managed machine the fix belongs in that Group Policy or MDM configuration rather than on the machine.

groups.name: The Windows Update agent
steps: Restart and try again.
If it keeps failing, run the Windows Update troubleshooter, then reset the Windows Update components as described for damaged downloads.

groups.name: A refused sign-in
steps: Look at the account in the event, and at where the attempt came from: a mapped drive, a service or a scheduled task still holding an old password retries on its own.
Many attempts against one account look like a guessed password or a stale credential; attempts against many accounts from one source look like password spraying.

codes.name: ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND
codes.meaning: The system cannot find the file specified.

codes.name: ERROR_PATH_NOT_FOUND
codes.meaning: The servicing stack cannot reach a path it needs.

codes.name: E_ACCESSDENIED
codes.meaning: Access was denied: file system or registry permissions were changed and the servicing stack no longer has the access it needs.

codes.name: ERROR_INVALID_DATA
codes.meaning: Data that is not valid was downloaded, or the download is corrupted.
codes.action: Download the update again, then install it.

codes.name: E_OUTOFMEMORY
codes.meaning: Not enough memory was available to complete the operation.

codes.name: ERROR_SHARING_VIOLATION
codes.meaning: A file could not be replaced because another process is using it, usually an antivirus, antimalware or backup program scanning it.
codes.action: Restart in a clean boot and install again. If it still fails, Process Monitor recorded during the installation shows which process holds the file named in CBS.log.

codes.name: E_INVALIDARG
codes.meaning: One or more arguments are not valid.

codes.name: ERROR_DISK_FULL
codes.meaning: There is not enough space on the disk.

codes.name: ERROR_SERVICE_DISABLED
codes.meaning: The Windows Update service is disabled or not running.
codes.action: Set the Windows Update service (wuauserv) back to Manual and start it. A tool that turns updates off is the usual cause.

codes.name: ERROR_NOT_FOUND
codes.meaning: Element not found. During a driver update it means details of the driver, such as its architecture, are missing from the registry.
codes.action: Microsoft describes adding the missing Arch value under HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ComponentBasedServicing\DriverOperations, from the Identity value of the same entry, then installing again.

codes.name: ERROR_PRIVILEGE_NOT_HELD
codes.meaning: The user does not hold the privilege needed for the operation.
codes.action: Sign in with an account that is a local administrator, then run it again.

codes.name: ERROR_FILE_CORRUPT
codes.meaning: The file or directory is corrupted and unreadable.

codes.name: ERROR_TIMEOUT
codes.meaning: The operation returned because its time limit expired.

codes.name: ERROR_INSTALL_FAILURE
codes.meaning: Fatal error during installation.
codes.action: Read the log of the installer that failed. For an update of the Windows Recovery Environment the recovery partition can be too small: Microsoft describes resizing it in KB5028997.

codes.name: RPC_S_CALL_FAILED
codes.meaning: The remote procedure call failed. When installing a cumulative update, the previous one can be left corrupted.

codes.name: ERROR_FAIL_REBOOT_REQUIRED
codes.meaning: The operation failed and a restart is needed to roll back the changes. A policy that sets the Windows Installer or TrustedInstaller service to Manual can keep the pending operations from completing.
codes.action: Let the TrustedInstaller and Windows Installer services use their default startup type, then restart. If the pending operations stay, Microsoft describes reverting them from the recovery environment with dism /Image:C:\ /Cleanup-Image /RevertPendingActions.

codes.name: ERROR_SXS_ASSEMBLY_MISSING
codes.meaning: The referenced assembly could not be found, usually a component left partially installed.

codes.name: ERROR_SXS_COMPONENT_STORE_CORRUPT
codes.meaning: The component store is in an inconsistent state.

codes.name: ERROR_SXS_TRANSACTION_CLOSURE_INCOMPLETE
codes.meaning: One or more required members of the transaction are not present.

codes.name: CBS_E_SOURCE_MISSING
codes.meaning: The source for a package or file was not found: the component store is damaged.
codes.action: For a feature such as .NET Framework 3.5, point DISM at installation media with /Source.

codes.name: CBS_E_ABORT
codes.meaning: The servicing transaction exceeded its time limit.
codes.action: Give the machine more processor and memory, a virtual machine especially, then install again.

codes.name: CBS_E_CANNOT_UNINSTALL
codes.meaning: The package cannot be uninstalled, usually because a component is partially installed.

codes.name: CBS_E_STORE_CORRUPTION
codes.meaning: The component store is corrupted.

codes.name: CBS_E_HANG_DETECTED
codes.meaning: The servicing operation stopped responding. It usually follows 0x800F0821.
codes.action: Give the machine more processor and memory, a virtual machine especially, then install again.

codes.name: CBS_E_INSTALLERS_FAILED
codes.meaning: One of the installers of the update failed, and the update rolled back.

codes.name: WININET_E_TIMEOUT
codes.meaning: The scan for updates timed out: the update source could not be reached.

codes.name: WININET_E_CANNOT_CONNECT
codes.meaning: The connection to the update server could not be established.

codes.name: WININET_E_CONNECTION_ABORTED
codes.meaning: The connection with the server was closed abnormally, and BITS could not transfer the file.
codes.action: Run BITSADMIN /LIST /ALLUSERS /VERBOSE, find the file behind this code, and try to download it with the proxy settings of the organization.

codes.name: WININET_E_DECODING_FAILED
codes.meaning: The content received could not be decoded. Microsoft names TLS 1.2 not configured correctly on the client.
codes.action: Make sure TLS 1.2 is enabled for WinHTTP. A wrong date and time break the certificate check the same way.

codes.name: BG_E_VALIDATION_FAILED
codes.meaning: A downloaded file did not pass validation.
codes.action: Make sure no firewall or filtering device alters the downloads: it can hand the client responses that are not the file.

codes.meaning: The download timed out, reported by Delivery Optimization.

codes.name: MOSETUP_E_SETUP_PLATFORM
codes.meaning: Generic rollback: the upgrade was undone, in most cases because of an incompatible driver. The extend code after it names the phase.

codes.name: MOSETUP_E_CLEANUP_PENDING
codes.meaning: A cleanup from a previous installation attempt is still pending, and a restart is required.
codes.action: Restart and run setup again. If that is not enough, run Disk Cleanup with system files.

codes.name: MOSETUP_E_COMPAT_SYSREQ_BLOCK
codes.meaning: The computer does not meet the minimum requirements of this version of Windows.
codes.action: Compare the machine with the requirements, then read the compatibility report of setup.

codes.meaning: The system did not pass the minimum requirements to install the update.
codes.action: Get the latest firmware and drivers from the hardware vendor.

codes.name: MOSETUP_E_COMPAT_MIGCHOICE_BLOCK
codes.meaning: The migration choice selected is not available, for example Enterprise to Home.

codes.name: MOSETUP_E_COMPAT_INSTALLREQ_BLOCK
codes.meaning: Setup found a compatibility issue to act on, such as an incompatible application.
codes.action: Uninstall or update the application named in the compatibility report, then run setup again.

codes.name: MOSETUP_E_INSTALLDISKSPACE_BLOCK
codes.meaning: The computer does not have enough free space to install.
WSUS downloaded content it cannot use because a decryption key is missing.
A device driver error occurred during user data migration.
codes.action: Get updated drivers from the hardware vendor, and keep an internet connection during the upgrade.

codes.meaning: An unexpected error occurred while downloading the files required for the upgrade.
codes.action: Download and run the media creation tool instead.

codes.meaning: Writing data to the system drive could not be completed, possibly because write access to the disk failed.

codes.name: STATUS_LOGON_FAILURE
codes.meaning: The user name or the password is wrong. The sub status says which.

codes.name: STATUS_WRONG_PASSWORD
codes.meaning: The account exists but the password is wrong.

codes.name: STATUS_NO_SUCH_USER
codes.meaning: The user name does not exist.

codes.name: STATUS_ACCOUNT_LOCKED_OUT
codes.meaning: The account is locked out.

codes.name: STATUS_ACCOUNT_DISABLED
codes.meaning: The account is disabled. Windows itself tries the disabled Guest account when the Sharing tab of a folder is opened, which is not an attack.

codes.name: STATUS_INVALID_LOGON_HOURS
codes.meaning: The account has time restrictions and cannot sign in at this time.

codes.name: STATUS_INVALID_WORKSTATION
codes.meaning: The account is not allowed to sign in from this computer.

codes.name: STATUS_PASSWORD_EXPIRED
codes.meaning: The password of the account has expired.

codes.name: STATUS_ACCOUNT_EXPIRED
codes.meaning: The account has expired.

codes.name: STATUS_PASSWORD_MUST_CHANGE
codes.meaning: The password must be changed at the next sign-in.

codes.name: STATUS_LOGON_TYPE_NOT_GRANTED
codes.meaning: The account is not granted this kind of sign-in on this computer, such as Allow log on locally or Allow log on through Remote Desktop Services.

codes.name: STATUS_NO_LOGON_SERVERS
codes.meaning: No domain controller was available to validate the sign-in.
codes.action: Diagnostics, Sign-in and management shows whether a domain controller is reached.

codes.name: STATUS_TIME_DIFFERENCE_AT_DC
codes.meaning: The clocks of this computer and of the domain controller differ too much for Kerberos.
codes.action: Diagnostics, Sign-in and management shows the clock offset against the domain controller.

codes.name: STATUS_AUTHENTICATION_FIREWALL_FAILED
codes.meaning: The computer being signed in to is protected by an authentication firewall, and the account is not allowed to authenticate to it.

codes.name: WU_S_SERVICE_STOP
codes.meaning: Windows Update Agent was stopped successfully.

codes.name: WU_S_SELFUPDATE
codes.meaning: Windows Update Agent updated itself.

codes.name: WU_S_UPDATE_ERROR
codes.meaning: The operation completed, but there were errors applying the updates.

codes.name: WU_S_REBOOT_REQUIRED
codes.meaning: The system must be restarted to complete the installation of the update.

codes.name: WU_S_ALREADY_INSTALLED
codes.meaning: The update to be installed is already installed on the system.

codes.name: WU_S_ALREADY_UNINSTALLED
codes.meaning: The update to be removed is not installed on the system.

codes.name: WU_S_ALREADY_DOWNLOADED
codes.meaning: The update to be downloaded has already been downloaded.

codes.name: WU_E_NO_SERVICE
codes.meaning: Windows Update Agent was unable to provide the service.

codes.name: WU_E_MAX_CAPACITY_REACHED
codes.meaning: The maximum capacity of the service was exceeded.

codes.name: WU_E_UNKNOWN_ID
codes.meaning: An ID cannot be found.

codes.name: WU_E_NOT_INITIALIZED
codes.meaning: The object could not be initialized.

codes.name: WU_E_RANGEOVERLAP
codes.meaning: The update handler requested a byte range overlapping a previously requested range.

codes.name: WU_E_TOOMANYRANGES
codes.meaning: The requested number of byte ranges exceeds the maximum number.

codes.name: WU_E_INVALIDINDEX
codes.meaning: The index to a collection was invalid.

codes.name: WU_E_ITEMNOTFOUND
codes.meaning: The key for the item queried could not be found.

codes.name: WU_E_OPERATIONINPROGRESS
codes.meaning: Another conflicting operation was in progress: some operations, such as installation, cannot run twice at the same time.
codes.action: Wait for the installation in progress to finish, or restart, then try again.

codes.name: WU_E_COULDNOTCANCEL
codes.meaning: Cancelling the operation was not allowed.

codes.name: WU_E_CALL_CANCELLED
codes.meaning: The operation was cancelled, by the user or by the service.
codes.action: Run it again.

codes.name: WU_E_NOOP
codes.meaning: No operation was required.

codes.name: WU_E_XML_MISSINGDATA
codes.meaning: Windows Update Agent could not find required information in the XML data of the update.

codes.name: WU_E_XML_INVALID
codes.meaning: Windows Update Agent found information that is not valid in the XML data of the update.
codes.action: Install the latest Windows Update Agent: some drivers carry metadata an older agent rejects.

codes.name: WU_E_CYCLE_DETECTED
codes.meaning: Circular update relationships were detected in the metadata.

codes.name: WU_E_TOO_DEEP_RELATION
codes.meaning: Update relationships too deep to evaluate were evaluated.

codes.name: WU_E_INVALID_RELATIONSHIP
codes.meaning: An invalid update relationship was detected.

codes.name: WU_E_REG_VALUE_INVALID
codes.meaning: An invalid registry value was read.

codes.name: WU_E_DUPLICATE_ITEM
codes.meaning: The operation tried to add a duplicate item to a list.

codes.name: WU_E_INSTALL_NOT_ALLOWED
codes.meaning: An installation was attempted while another was in progress or while a mandatory restart was pending.

codes.name: WU_E_NOT_APPLICABLE
codes.meaning: No applicable updates. For an upgrade, it means the upgrade is not available for this edition, or a policy of the organization prevents it.

codes.name: WU_E_NO_USERTOKEN
codes.meaning: The operation failed because a required user token is missing.

codes.name: WU_E_EXCLUSIVE_INSTALL_CONFLICT
codes.meaning: An exclusive update cannot be installed with other updates at the same time.
codes.action: Install that update on its own, then the others.

codes.name: WU_E_POLICY_NOT_SET
codes.meaning: A policy value was not set.

codes.name: WU_E_SELFUPDATE_IN_PROGRESS
codes.meaning: The operation could not be performed because Windows Update Agent is updating itself.
codes.action: Wait a few minutes, then try again.

codes.name: WU_E_INVALID_UPDATE
codes.meaning: An update contains invalid metadata.

codes.name: WU_E_SERVICE_STOP
codes.meaning: The operation did not complete because the service or the system was shutting down.

codes.name: WU_E_NO_CONNECTION
codes.meaning: The operation did not complete because the network connection was unavailable.

codes.name: WU_E_NO_INTERACTIVE_USER
codes.meaning: The operation did not complete because nobody is signed in interactively.
codes.action: Sign in to the device to start the installation, and let it restart.

codes.name: WU_E_TIME_OUT
codes.meaning: The operation did not complete because it timed out.

codes.name: WU_E_ALL_UPDATES_FAILED
codes.meaning: The operation failed for all the updates. Microsoft names antivirus software blocking folders such as SoftwareDistribution as the most common cause.

codes.name: WU_E_EULAS_DECLINED
codes.meaning: The license terms for all updates were declined.

codes.name: WU_E_NO_UPDATE
codes.meaning: There are no updates.

codes.name: WU_E_USER_ACCESS_DISABLED
codes.meaning: Group Policy settings prevented access to Windows Update.

codes.name: WU_E_INVALID_UPDATE_TYPE
codes.meaning: The type of update is invalid.

codes.name: WU_E_URL_TOO_LONG
codes.meaning: The URL exceeded the maximum length.

codes.name: WU_E_UNINSTALL_NOT_ALLOWED
codes.meaning: The update could not be uninstalled because the request did not come from a WSUS server.

codes.name: WU_E_INVALID_PRODUCT_LICENSE
codes.meaning: The search may have missed some updates because there is an unlicensed application on the system.

codes.name: WU_E_MISSING_HANDLER
codes.meaning: A component required to detect applicable updates was missing.

codes.name: WU_E_LEGACYSERVER
codes.meaning: An operation did not complete because it requires a newer version of the server.

codes.name: WU_E_BIN_SOURCE_ABSENT
codes.meaning: A delta-compressed update could not be installed because it required the source.

codes.name: WU_E_SOURCE_ABSENT
codes.meaning: A full-file update could not be installed because it required the source.

codes.name: WU_E_WU_DISABLED
codes.meaning: Access to an unmanaged server is not allowed.

codes.name: WU_E_CALL_CANCELLED_BY_POLICY
codes.meaning: The operation did not complete because the DisableWindowsUpdateAccess policy was set.

codes.name: WU_E_INVALID_PROXY_SERVER
codes.meaning: The format of the proxy list was invalid.

codes.name: WU_E_INVALID_FILE
codes.meaning: The file is in the wrong format.

codes.name: WU_E_INVALID_CRITERIA
codes.meaning: The search criteria string was invalid.

codes.name: WU_E_EULA_UNAVAILABLE
codes.meaning: The license terms could not be downloaded.

codes.name: WU_E_DOWNLOAD_FAILED
codes.meaning: The update failed to download.

codes.name: WU_E_UPDATE_NOT_PROCESSED
codes.meaning: The update was not processed.

codes.name: WU_E_INVALID_OPERATION
codes.meaning: The current state of the object did not allow the operation.

codes.name: WU_E_NOT_SUPPORTED
codes.meaning: The functionality for the operation is not supported.

codes.name: WU_E_WINHTTP_INVALID_FILE
codes.meaning: The downloaded file has an unexpected content type, which a proxy or a filter answering in place of the server can cause.

codes.name: WU_E_TOO_MANY_RESYNC
codes.meaning: The agent was asked by the server to synchronize again too many times.

codes.name: WU_E_NO_SERVER_CORE_SUPPORT
codes.meaning: The Windows Update Agent API method does not run on a Server Core installation.

codes.name: WU_E_SYSPREP_IN_PROGRESS
codes.meaning: The service is not available while sysprep is running.

codes.name: WU_E_UNKNOWN_SERVICE
codes.meaning: The update service is no longer registered with Automatic Updates.

codes.name: WU_E_NO_UI_SUPPORT
codes.meaning: There is no support for the Windows Update Agent user interface.

codes.name: WU_E_UNEXPECTED
codes.meaning: An operation failed for reasons not covered by another error code.

codes.name: WU_E_MSI_WRONG_VERSION
codes.meaning: The search may have missed some updates because Windows Installer is older than version 3.1.

codes.name: WU_E_MSI_NOT_CONFIGURED
codes.meaning: The search may have missed some updates because Windows Installer is not configured.

codes.name: WU_E_MSP_DISABLED
codes.meaning: The search may have missed some updates because a policy disabled Windows Installer patching.

codes.name: WU_E_MSI_WRONG_APP_CONTEXT
codes.meaning: An update could not be applied because the application is installed per user.

codes.name: WU_E_MSP_UNEXPECTED
codes.meaning: The search may have missed some updates because Windows Installer failed.

codes.name: WU_E_UH_REMOTEUNAVAILABLE
codes.meaning: A request for a remote update handler could not be completed because no remote process is available.

codes.name: WU_E_UH_LOCALONLY
codes.meaning: A request for a remote update handler could not be completed because the handler is local only.

codes.name: WU_E_UH_UNKNOWNHANDLER
codes.meaning: A request for an update handler could not be completed because the handler could not be recognized.

codes.name: WU_E_UH_REMOTEALREADYACTIVE
codes.meaning: A remote update handler could not be created because one already exists.

codes.name: WU_E_UH_DOESNOTSUPPORTACTION
codes.meaning: The update does not support the installation or the removal that was requested.

codes.name: WU_E_UH_WRONGHANDLER
codes.meaning: An operation did not complete because the wrong handler was specified.

codes.name: WU_E_UH_INVALIDMETADATA
codes.meaning: A handler operation could not be completed because the update contains invalid metadata.

codes.name: WU_E_UH_INSTALLERHUNG
codes.meaning: An operation could not be completed because the installer exceeded its time limit.

codes.name: WU_E_UH_OPERATIONCANCELLED
codes.meaning: An operation of the update handler was cancelled.

codes.name: WU_E_UH_BADHANDLERXML
codes.meaning: An operation could not be completed because the handler-specific metadata is invalid.

codes.name: WU_E_UH_CANREQUIREINPUT
codes.meaning: The update could not be installed because it requires user input.

codes.name: WU_E_UH_INSTALLERFAILURE
codes.meaning: The installer failed to install or uninstall one or more updates.

codes.name: WU_E_UH_FALLBACKTOSELFCONTAINED
codes.meaning: The update handler should download self-contained content rather than delta-compressed content.

codes.name: WU_E_UH_NEEDANOTHERDOWNLOAD
codes.meaning: The update was not installed because it needs to be downloaded again.

codes.name: WU_E_UH_NOTIFYFAILURE
codes.meaning: The update handler failed to send the status of the installation or removal.

codes.name: WU_E_UH_INCONSISTENT_FILE_NAMES
codes.meaning: The file names in the update metadata and in the update package are inconsistent.

codes.name: WU_E_UH_FALLBACKERROR
codes.meaning: The update handler failed to fall back to the self-contained content.

codes.name: WU_E_UH_TOOMANYDOWNLOADREQUESTS
codes.meaning: The update handler exceeded the maximum number of download requests.

codes.name: WU_E_UH_UNEXPECTEDCBSRESPONSE
codes.meaning: The update handler received an unexpected response from the servicing stack (CBS).

codes.name: WU_E_UH_BADCBSPACKAGEID
codes.meaning: The update metadata contains an invalid servicing package identifier.

codes.name: WU_E_UH_POSTREBOOTSTILLPENDING
codes.meaning: The operation after the restart is still in progress for the update.

codes.name: WU_E_UH_POSTREBOOTRESULTUNKNOWN
codes.meaning: The result of the operation after the restart could not be determined.

codes.name: WU_E_UH_POSTREBOOTUNEXPECTEDSTATE
codes.meaning: The state of the update after its post-restart operation completed is unexpected.

codes.name: WU_E_UH_NEW_SERVICING_STACK_REQUIRED
codes.meaning: The servicing stack must be updated before this update is downloaded or installed.
codes.action: Install the latest servicing stack update first, then this one.

codes.name: WU_E_UH_UNEXPECTED
codes.meaning: An update handler error not covered by another code.

codes.name: WU_E_INSTALLATION_RESULTS_UNKNOWN_VERSION
codes.meaning: The results of download and installation could not be read from the registry: unrecognized data format version.

codes.name: WU_E_INSTALLATION_RESULTS_INVALID_DATA
codes.meaning: The results of download and installation could not be read from the registry: invalid data format.

codes.name: WU_E_INSTALLATION_RESULTS_NOT_FOUND
codes.meaning: The results of download and installation are not available; the operation may have failed to start.

codes.name: WU_E_TRAYICON_FAILURE
codes.meaning: Creating an icon in the notification area failed.

codes.name: WU_E_NON_UI_MODE
codes.meaning: The user interface cannot be shown in non-UI mode; its modules may not be installed.

codes.name: WU_E_WUCLTUI_UNSUPPORTED_VERSION
codes.meaning: Unsupported version of the functions exported by the Windows Update client user interface.

codes.name: WU_E_AUCLIENT_UNEXPECTED
codes.meaning: A user interface error not covered by another code.

codes.name: WU_E_SERVICEPROP_NOTAVAIL
codes.meaning: The requested service property is not available.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_SOAPCLIENT_BASE
codes.meaning: Base of the SOAP client error codes.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_SOAPCLIENT_INITIALIZE
codes.meaning: Initialization of the SOAP client failed, possibly because of an MSXML installation failure.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_SOAPCLIENT_OUTOFMEMORY
codes.meaning: The SOAP client ran out of memory.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_SOAPCLIENT_GENERATE
codes.meaning: The SOAP client failed to generate the request.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_SOAPCLIENT_CONNECT
codes.meaning: The SOAP client failed to connect to the server.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_SOAPCLIENT_SEND
codes.meaning: The SOAP client failed to send a message.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_SOAPCLIENT_SERVER
codes.meaning: The SOAP client failed because of a server error.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_SOAPCLIENT_SOAPFAULT
codes.meaning: The SOAP client failed because of a SOAP fault. Microsoft describes it as Windows being unable to renew its Windows Update cookies with the WSUS server.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_SOAPCLIENT_PARSEFAULT
codes.meaning: The SOAP client failed to parse a SOAP fault.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_SOAPCLIENT_READ
codes.meaning: The SOAP client failed while reading the response from the server.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_SOAPCLIENT_PARSE
codes.meaning: The SOAP client failed to parse the response from the server.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_SOAP_VERSION
codes.meaning: The SOAP client found an unrecognizable namespace for the SOAP envelope.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_SOAP_MUST_UNDERSTAND
codes.meaning: The SOAP client was unable to understand a header.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_SOAP_CLIENT
codes.meaning: The SOAP client found the message was malformed.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_SOAP_SERVER
codes.meaning: The SOAP message could not be processed because of a server error; send it again later.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_WMI_ERROR
codes.meaning: There was an unspecified WMI error.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_EXCEEDED_MAX_SERVER_TRIPS
codes.meaning: The number of round trips to the server exceeded the maximum limit.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_SUS_SERVER_NOT_SET
codes.meaning: The WUServer policy value is missing in the registry.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_DOUBLE_INITIALIZATION
codes.meaning: Initialization failed because the object was already initialized.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_INVALID_COMPUTER_NAME
codes.meaning: The computer name could not be determined.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_REFRESH_CACHE_REQUIRED
codes.meaning: The server changed or the cookie was invalid; the internal cache must be refreshed and the request retried.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_HTTP_STATUS_BAD_REQUEST
codes.meaning: HTTP 400: the server could not process the request because of invalid syntax.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_HTTP_STATUS_DENIED
codes.meaning: HTTP 401: the requested resource requires user authentication.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_HTTP_STATUS_FORBIDDEN
codes.meaning: HTTP 403: the server understood the request but declined it. During an upgrade Microsoft points at a proxy server between the machine and Windows Update.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_HTTP_STATUS_NOT_FOUND
codes.meaning: HTTP 404: the server cannot find the requested address.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_HTTP_STATUS_BAD_METHOD
codes.meaning: HTTP 405: the HTTP method is not allowed.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_HTTP_STATUS_PROXY_AUTH_REQ
codes.meaning: HTTP 407: the proxy server requires authentication, which the Windows Update agent cannot give.
codes.action: Let the update source through the proxy without user authentication, and check the WinHTTP proxy of the machine in Diagnostics, Proxy.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_HTTP_STATUS_REQUEST_TIMEOUT
codes.meaning: HTTP 408: the server timed out waiting for the request.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_HTTP_STATUS_CONFLICT
codes.meaning: HTTP 409: the request conflicts with the current state of the resource.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_HTTP_STATUS_GONE
codes.meaning: HTTP 410: the requested resource is no longer available on the server.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_HTTP_STATUS_SERVER_ERROR
codes.meaning: HTTP 500: an error inside the server prevented it from answering.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_HTTP_STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED
codes.meaning: The server does not support the functionality required to answer.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_HTTP_STATUS_BAD_GATEWAY
codes.meaning: HTTP 502: the server, acting as a gateway or a proxy, received an invalid response from the server behind it.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_HTTP_STATUS_SERVICE_UNAVAIL
codes.meaning: HTTP 503: the service is temporarily overloaded, or the configured update source cannot be reached.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_HTTP_STATUS_GATEWAY_TIMEOUT
codes.meaning: The request timed out waiting for a gateway.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_HTTP_STATUS_VERSION_NOT_SUP
codes.meaning: HTTP 505: the server does not support the HTTP version used.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_FILE_LOCATIONS_CHANGED
codes.meaning: The operation failed because a file location changed; the internal state must be refreshed.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_REGISTRATION_NOT_SUPPORTED
codes.meaning: Windows Update Agent does not support registration with a server that is not WSUS.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_NO_AUTH_PLUGINS_REQUESTED
codes.meaning: The server returned an empty authentication information list.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_NO_AUTH_COOKIES_CREATED
codes.meaning: Windows Update Agent was unable to create any valid authentication cookie.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_INVALID_CONFIG_PROP
codes.meaning: A configuration property value was wrong.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_CONFIG_PROP_MISSING
codes.meaning: A configuration property value was missing.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_HTTP_STATUS_NOT_MAPPED
codes.meaning: The HTTP request could not be completed, for a reason no other code describes.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_WINHTTP_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED
codes.meaning: The name of the proxy server or of the update server cannot be resolved.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_ECP_SUCCEEDED_WITH_ERRORS
codes.meaning: Processing of an external cab file completed with some errors.
codes.action: Web filtering software such as Lightspeed Rocket can cause it: add the addresses of the machines to its exceptions.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_ECP_INIT_FAILED
codes.meaning: The external cab processor initialization did not complete.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_ECP_INVALID_FILE_FORMAT
codes.meaning: The format of a metadata file was invalid.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_ECP_INVALID_METADATA
codes.meaning: The external cab processor found invalid metadata.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_ECP_FAILURE_TO_EXTRACT_DIGEST
codes.meaning: The file digest could not be extracted from an external cab file.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_ECP_FAILURE_TO_DECOMPRESS_CAB_FILE
codes.meaning: An external cab file could not be decompressed.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_ECP_FILE_LOCATION_ERROR
codes.meaning: The external cab processor was unable to get file locations.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_UNEXPECTED
codes.meaning: A communication error not covered by another code.

codes.name: WU_E_REDIRECTOR_LOAD_XML
codes.meaning: The redirector XML document could not be loaded.

codes.name: WU_E_REDIRECTOR_S_FALSE
codes.meaning: The redirector XML document is missing some required information.

codes.name: WU_E_REDIRECTOR_ID_SMALLER
codes.meaning: The redirector identifier in the downloaded cab is lower than in the cached one.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_SAME_REDIR_ID
codes.meaning: A redirector cab with a new identifier could not be downloaded from the server during recovery.

codes.name: WU_E_PT_NO_MANAGED_RECOVER
codes.meaning: A redirector recovery did not complete because the server is managed.

codes.name: WU_E_REDIRECTOR_UNEXPECTED
codes.meaning: The redirector failed for reasons not covered by another code.

codes.name: WU_E_DM_URLNOTAVAILABLE
codes.meaning: A download could not be completed because the requested file does not have an address.

codes.name: WU_E_DM_INCORRECTFILEHASH
codes.meaning: A download could not be completed because the file digest was not recognized.

codes.name: WU_E_DM_UNKNOWNALGORITHM
codes.meaning: A download could not be completed because the file metadata requested an unrecognized hash algorithm.

codes.name: WU_E_DM_NEEDDOWNLOADREQUEST
codes.meaning: A download request is required from the download handler.

codes.name: WU_E_DM_NONETWORK
codes.meaning: A download could not be completed because the network connection was unavailable.

codes.name: WU_E_DM_WRONGBITSVERSION
codes.meaning: A download could not be completed because the version of BITS is incompatible.

codes.name: WU_E_DM_NOTDOWNLOADED
codes.meaning: The update has not been downloaded.
codes.action: For an upgrade, try another way: the media creation tool, an ISO or a USB drive.

codes.name: WU_E_DM_FAILTOCONNECTTOBITS
codes.meaning: The download manager was unable to connect to BITS.
codes.action: Check that the Background Intelligent Transfer Service (BITS) is not disabled, then try again.

codes.name: WU_E_DM_BITSTRANSFERERROR
codes.meaning: There was an unspecified BITS transfer error.

codes.name: WU_E_DM_DOWNLOADLOCATIONCHANGED
codes.meaning: A download must be restarted because the location of its source changed.

codes.name: WU_E_DM_CONTENTCHANGED
codes.meaning: A download must be restarted because the update content changed in a new revision.

codes.name: WU_E_DM_UNAUTHORIZED_LOCAL_USER
codes.meaning: The download failed because the local user was denied authorization to download the content.
codes.action: Install updates with an account that has the right to, a local administrator.

codes.name: WU_E_DM_UNEXPECTED
codes.meaning: A download manager error not covered by another code.

codes.name: WU_E_OL_INVALID_SCANFILE
codes.meaning: An operation could not be completed because the scan package was invalid.

codes.name: WU_E_OL_NEWCLIENT_REQUIRED
codes.meaning: The scan package requires a newer version of Windows Update Agent.

codes.name: WU_E_OL_UNEXPECTED
codes.meaning: A search using the scan package failed.

codes.name: WU_E_DS_SHUTDOWN
codes.meaning: An operation failed because Windows Update Agent is shutting down.

codes.name: WU_E_DS_INUSE
codes.meaning: An operation failed because the data store was in use.

codes.name: WU_E_DS_INVALID
codes.meaning: The current and the expected states of the data store do not match.

codes.name: WU_E_DS_TABLEMISSING
codes.meaning: The data store is missing a table.

codes.name: WU_E_DS_TABLEINCORRECT
codes.meaning: The data store contains a table with unexpected columns.

codes.name: WU_E_DS_INVALIDTABLENAME
codes.meaning: A table could not be opened because it is not in the data store.

codes.name: WU_E_DS_BADVERSION
codes.meaning: The current and the expected versions of the data store do not match.

codes.name: WU_E_DS_NODATA
codes.meaning: The information requested is not in the data store.

codes.name: WU_E_DS_MISSINGDATA
codes.meaning: The data store is missing required information.

codes.name: WU_E_DS_MISSINGREF
codes.meaning: The data store is missing required information or has a reference to something missing.

codes.name: WU_E_DS_UNKNOWNHANDLER
codes.meaning: The update was not processed because its update handler could not be recognized.

codes.name: WU_E_DS_CANTDELETE
codes.meaning: The update was not deleted because one or more services still reference it.

codes.name: WU_E_DS_LOCKTIMEOUTEXPIRED
codes.meaning: A section of the data store could not be locked within the allotted time.

codes.name: WU_E_DS_NOCATEGORIES
codes.meaning: The category was not added because it has no parent categories and is not a top-level category.

codes.name: WU_E_DS_ROWEXISTS
codes.meaning: The row was not added because an existing row has the same primary key.

codes.name: WU_E_DS_STOREFILELOCKED
codes.meaning: The data store could not be initialized because another process locked it.

codes.name: WU_E_DS_CANNOTREGISTER
codes.meaning: The data store is not allowed to be registered with COM in the current process.

codes.name: WU_E_DS_UNABLETOSTART
codes.meaning: A data store object could not be created in another process.

codes.name: WU_E_DS_DUPLICATEUPDATEID
codes.meaning: The server sent the same update to the client with two different revision identifiers.

codes.name: WU_E_DS_UNKNOWNSERVICE
codes.meaning: An operation did not complete because the service is not in the data store.

codes.name: WU_E_DS_SERVICEEXPIRED
codes.meaning: An operation did not complete because the registration of the service has expired.

codes.name: WU_E_DS_DECLINENOTALLOWED
codes.meaning: Hiding an update was declined because it is mandatory or was deployed with a deadline.

codes.name: WU_E_DS_TABLESESSIONMISMATCH
codes.meaning: A table was not closed because it is not associated with the session.

codes.name: WU_E_DS_SESSIONLOCKMISMATCH
codes.meaning: A table was not closed because it is not associated with the session.

codes.name: WU_E_DS_NEEDWINDOWSSERVICE
codes.meaning: Removing or unregistering the built-in Windows Update service was declined.

codes.name: WU_E_DS_INVALIDOPERATION
codes.meaning: A request was declined because the operation is not allowed.

codes.name: WU_E_DS_SCHEMAMISMATCH
codes.meaning: The schema of the data store and of a table in a backup XML document do not match.

codes.name: WU_E_DS_RESETREQUIRED
codes.meaning: The data store requires a session reset.

codes.name: WU_E_DS_IMPERSONATED
codes.meaning: A data store operation did not complete because it was requested with an impersonated identity.

codes.name: WU_E_DS_UNEXPECTED
codes.meaning: A data store error not covered by another code.

codes.name: WU_E_INVENTORY_PARSEFAILED
codes.meaning: Parsing of the rule file failed.

codes.name: WU_E_INVENTORY_GET_INVENTORY_TYPE_FAILED
codes.meaning: Failed to get the requested inventory type from the server.

codes.name: WU_E_INVENTORY_RESULT_UPLOAD_FAILED
codes.meaning: Failed to upload the inventory result to the server.

codes.name: WU_E_INVENTORY_UNEXPECTED
codes.meaning: An inventory error not covered by another code.

codes.name: WU_E_INVENTORY_WMI_ERROR
codes.meaning: A WMI error occurred while enumerating the instances of a class.

codes.name: WU_E_AU_NOSERVICE
codes.meaning: Automatic Updates was unable to service incoming requests.

codes.name: WU_E_AU_NONLEGACYSERVER
codes.meaning: The old Automatic Updates client stopped because the WSUS server was upgraded.

codes.name: WU_E_AU_LEGACYCLIENTDISABLED
codes.meaning: The old version of the Automatic Updates client was disabled.

codes.name: WU_E_AU_PAUSED
codes.meaning: Automatic Updates could not process incoming requests because it was paused.

codes.name: WU_E_AU_NO_REGISTERED_SERVICE
codes.meaning: No unmanaged service is registered with Automatic Updates.

codes.name: USO_E_SERVICE_SHUTTING_DOWN
codes.meaning: The Windows Update service is shutting down, which can happen after a long time of inactivity.
codes.action: Keep the system active and its connections up until the installation completes.

codes.name: WU_E_AU_UNEXPECTED
codes.meaning: An Automatic Updates error not covered by another code.

codes.name: WU_E_DRV_PRUNED
codes.meaning: A driver was skipped. It is not a fatal error.

codes.name: WU_E_DRV_NOPROP_OR_LEGACY
codes.meaning: A property of the driver could not be found; it may not conform to the required specifications.

codes.name: WU_E_DRV_REG_MISMATCH
codes.meaning: The registry type read for the driver does not match the expected type.

codes.name: WU_E_DRV_NO_METADATA
codes.meaning: The driver update is missing metadata.

codes.name: WU_E_DRV_MISSING_ATTRIBUTE
codes.meaning: The driver update is missing a required attribute.

codes.name: WU_E_DRV_SYNC_FAILED
codes.meaning: Driver synchronization failed.

codes.name: WU_E_DRV_NO_PRINTER_CONTENT
codes.meaning: Information required to synchronize applicable printers is missing.

codes.name: WU_E_DRV_UNEXPECTED
codes.meaning: A driver error not covered by another code.

codes.name: WU_E_SETUP_INVALID_INFDATA
codes.meaning: Windows Update Agent could not be updated because an INF file contains invalid information.

codes.name: WU_E_SETUP_INVALID_IDENTDATA
codes.meaning: Windows Update Agent could not be updated because wuident.cab contains invalid information.

codes.name: WU_E_SETUP_ALREADY_INITIALIZED
codes.meaning: Windows Update Agent could not be updated because setup initialization ran twice.

codes.name: WU_E_SETUP_NOT_INITIALIZED
codes.meaning: Windows Update Agent could not be updated because setup initialization never completed.

codes.name: WU_E_SETUP_SOURCE_VERSION_MISMATCH
codes.meaning: Windows Update Agent could not be updated because the versions in the INF do not match the source files.

codes.name: WU_E_SETUP_TARGET_VERSION_GREATER
codes.meaning: Windows Update Agent could not be updated because a file on the system is newer than its source.

codes.name: WU_E_SETUP_REGISTRATION_FAILED
codes.meaning: Windows Update Agent could not be updated because regsvr32.exe returned an error.

codes.name: WU_E_SETUP_SKIP_UPDATE
codes.meaning: An update of Windows Update Agent was skipped because of a directive in wuident.cab.
codes.action: WSUS may not be sending the agent self-update to clients: Microsoft describes the fix in KB920659.

codes.name: WU_E_SETUP_UNSUPPORTED_CONFIGURATION
codes.meaning: Windows Update Agent could not be updated because the system configuration is not supported.

codes.name: WU_E_SETUP_BLOCKED_CONFIGURATION
codes.meaning: Windows Update Agent could not be updated because the system is configured to block the update.

codes.name: WU_E_SETUP_REBOOT_TO_FIX
codes.meaning: Windows Update Agent could not be updated because a restart of the system is required.

codes.name: WU_E_SETUP_ALREADYRUNNING
codes.meaning: Windows Update Agent setup is already running.

codes.name: WU_E_SETUP_REBOOTREQUIRED
codes.meaning: The Windows Update Agent setup package requires a restart to complete.

codes.name: WU_E_SETUP_HANDLER_EXEC_FAILURE
codes.meaning: Windows Update Agent could not be updated because the setup handler failed.

codes.name: WU_E_SETUP_INVALID_REGISTRY_DATA
codes.meaning: Windows Update Agent could not be updated because the registry contains invalid information.

codes.name: WU_E_SETUP_WRONG_SERVER_VERSION
codes.meaning: Windows Update Agent could not be updated because the server has no update information for this version.

codes.name: WU_E_SETUP_UNEXPECTED
codes.meaning: Windows Update Agent could not be updated because of an error not covered by another code.

codes.name: WU_E_EE_UNKNOWN_EXPRESSION
codes.meaning: An expression evaluator operation could not be completed because an expression was unrecognized.

codes.name: WU_E_EE_INVALID_EXPRESSION
codes.meaning: An expression evaluator operation could not be completed because an expression was invalid.

codes.name: WU_E_EE_MISSING_METADATA
codes.meaning: An expression contains an incorrect number of metadata nodes.

codes.name: WU_E_EE_INVALID_VERSION
codes.meaning: The version of the serialized expression data is invalid.

codes.name: WU_E_EE_NOT_INITIALIZED
codes.meaning: The expression evaluator could not be initialized.

codes.name: WU_E_EE_INVALID_ATTRIBUTEDATA
codes.meaning: An expression evaluator operation could not be completed because there was an invalid attribute.

codes.name: WU_E_EE_CLUSTER_ERROR
codes.meaning: The cluster state of the computer could not be determined.

codes.name: WU_E_EE_UNEXPECTED
codes.meaning: An expression evaluator error not covered by another code.

codes.name: WU_E_REPORTER_EVENTCACHECORRUPT
codes.meaning: The event cache file was defective.

codes.name: WU_E_REPORTER_EVENTNAMESPACEPARSEFAILED
codes.meaning: The XML in the event namespace descriptor could not be parsed.

codes.name: WU_E_INVALID_EVENT
codes.meaning: The XML in the event namespace descriptor could not be parsed.

codes.name: WU_E_SERVER_BUSY
codes.meaning: The server rejected an event because it was too busy.

codes.name: WU_E_REPORTER_UNEXPECTED
codes.meaning: A reporter error not covered by another code.
